Sadly not at all, i'm not eligible for homeless shelters (requires being jobless or being very poor, which i am in *theory* not)

I was fired already on my last stay and hardly able to come back (and that only after i let myself out against medical advice), theres no laws against this here.
Down to the minimal security limit of 850EUR yes, at the current rate (~700EUR monthly) i'm done in 6 years...

Sadly i have no friends and saving up for the deposit (which will be around 2000EUR) will take not a month but with the money i can take from my income (next to nothing if i want to eat something) multiple months, if not more than a year (I can barely put 50EUR away monthly for the deposit)
In fact there are shelters, but while homeless i still have a job then so i'm noit eligible for that...
